Overlong headlines are truncated with an ellipsis, which reduces information completeness, so a threshold is set per platform.
map.情感词/数字为什么加分？: Why do emotional words and numbers earn bonus points?
map.具体数字（如「3个」）降低认知成本、制造确定感；情感/悬念词（如「绝了」「竟然」: Concrete numbers (such as "3") lower cognitive cost and create a sense of certainty, while emotional or suspense words (such as "amazing" or "unexpectedly") spark curiosity; both are common traits of high-CTR headlines. But stacking too many of them (2 or more emotional words) risks clickbait.
